title: CoworkerConfig
description: Behavioural knobs for a single coworker. Secrets, host binding, and development escape hatches stay in .env (see docs/adr/0007-config-file-vs-env-vars.md).

wake_mode.description: Activity source. 'tick' = periodic tick loop only. 'webhook' = wake HTTP server only (no scheduled ticks). 'both' = both (belt-and-suspenders; recommended).

extract_entities.description: Enable the per-tick entity evaluator that extracts people, projects, and workspace facts into state/entities and state/notes.md.

max_tools_per_tick.description: Maximum number of tool calls the coworker may chain within a single tick before the tick is force-closed.

pii_mask.description: Reversibly mask cloud identifiers (pod names, account IDs, IPs, UUIDs) in prompts so the LLM sees stable per-tick tokens instead of raw identifiers.

note_require_signed.description: Reject operator notes that lack a valid HMAC signature. Requires NOTE_HMAC_SECRET to be set; use bin/note-to.sh to write signed notes.

memory_promotions.description: Trust ladder for MEMORY.md promotions (AIC-131). 'confident' (default) — the weekly reflect ritual applies low-loss promotions itself, exactly as before; high-loss candidates queue as -candidate versions in memory_versions. 'gated' — every promotion queues as a -candidate and MEMORY.md is never touched in-ritual; approve with bin/aicw memory-approve. The queue is visible in state/memory-map.md and state/memory/DREAMS.md.

work_hours.description: Optional working-hours window. If omitted the coworker runs 24/7 (unchanged behaviour). If set, out-of-hours ticks behave per 'out_of_hours'. Webhooks, rituals and due promises always fire regardless.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'Europe/London'). Defaults to the system timezone if omitted.

days.description: ISO weekday numbers on which work_hours apply (1=Mon..7=Sun). Empty or omitted = every day.

start.description: HH:MM 24-hour local start time. If 'end' is earlier than 'start' the window spans midnight.

end.description: HH:MM 24-hour local end time. See 'start' for spanning-midnight semantics.

out_of_hours.description: Behaviour outside work_hours. 'webhook_only' pins tick base+max intervals to 24h (same as wake_mode=webhook, time-scoped). 'reduced' clamps the minimum tick interval to out_of_hours_interval_min minutes. 'normal' makes no cadence change.

out_of_hours_interval_min.description: Minimum tick interval in minutes when out-of-hours and out_of_hours='reduced'. Ignored for other modes.
